catalogue.name: The Tide Cult
catalogue.readme:
Force generation

The lists are divided into three unit categories; Command, Core and Special. When generating forces players must include:
● One (1) Command entry
● Max one (1) Special entry for each Core entry
● Max two (2) upgrades per full 300 points in their force. (Unless otherwise specified, a unit may only take an upgrade once).

Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points in their force, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above - one (1) FP lets you take:
● One (1) additional Command entry, (to a maximum of two (2))
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

Cost types:
p: Points
U: Upgrades
FP: Faction Points

sharedRules.name: Stellar Alignment
sharedRules.description:
Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Insurrection Assault: use when a friendly unit is deployed with Insertion. It receives one (1) less action marker.
● Back Underground: return one (1) friendly regular unit to staging and restore one (1) wound.
● Sabotage: use when an enemy unit enters the board across a board edge. It receives one (1) action marker.

sharedRules.name: Cult Bestial Leader
sharedRules.description: May attach to any Infiltration Beast unit.

sharedRules.name: Cult Standard Bearer
sharedRules.description: May attach to any non-vehicle unit.

sharedRules.name: Cult Revolutionaries
sharedRules.description: Deploy separately, may attach to non-vehicle/massive units.

sharedRules.name: Cult Skyhook
sharedRules.description: Unit may have one option active at a time; switch option in staging.

sharedRules.name: Prepared Insurrection
sharedRules.description: +1 FP, use only on FP powers. Max 2.

sharedRules.name: Familiar
sharedRules.description: You may re-roll any dice of a friendly mystic power roll, one use.

sharedRules.name: Wounds in the Earth
sharedRules.description: May remove one (1) terrain feature within 9” once per game.

sharedRules.name: Scrap armour
sharedRules.description: Model has 1 additional Wound at Defence(7). This does not count towards unit size.

sharedRules.name: One-shot AA/AT gunner
sharedRules.description: Unit can attack with One-shot AA or AT as a free priority action.

sharedRules.name: Enclave Creed
sharedRules.description:
You may field 1x entry from the Enclave force list (counting as command/core/special as usual).

You may not field Bestial Progenitor or Xenomorphs, and all instances of “Serfmind” is replaced with “Dark Arts”.

Spend one (1) Faction Point:
● Insurrection Assault: use when a friendly unit is deployed with Insertion. It receives one (1) less action marker.
● Back Underground: return one (1) friendly regular unit to staging and restore one (1) wound.
● Sabotage: use when an enemy unit enters the board across a board edge. It receives one (1) action marker.
